title: Home Oxygen Therapy Billing Calendar: The Suspension Date of an Inpatient or Skilled Nursing Stay
content:
# The Suspension Date — Home Oxygen Therapy

A Home Oxygen Therapy suspension for an inpatient or skilled nursing stay is dated on the day the stay is reported, written as YYYY-MM-DD.

## Elements of the date

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Day used | the day the stay is reported to Summit Ridge |
| Format | four-digit year, two-digit month, two-digit day, joined by hyphens |
| Where it appears | as the suspension date of the oxygen record |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A family caregiver reports on 9 November 2025 that the patient was admitted to a skilled nursing facility.

1. The day the stay is reported is 9 November 2025.
2. The suspension is dated 2025-11-09.

## Questions answered

**Is the suspension date the same for an inpatient hospital stay and a skilled nursing stay?** Yes; both are dated on the day the stay is reported.

**How is the date written?** As YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2025-11-09.
